ruleDefinitions.name: Group Membership Reconnaissance Via Whoami.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of whoami.exe with the /group command line flag to show group membership for the current user, account type, security identifiers (SID), and attributes.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\whoami\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "whoami\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/groups.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-groups.*")))
